plan.title: Show action description in Run next action button
plan.overview: Replace inline play button with expandable ActionItem child node under each TaskItem. The ActionItem displays the action label with task ID (e.g., "Scope task 003") and description, using a green play ThemeIcon. Clicking the ActionItem triggers the existing kanban.runNextAction command. This follows the FileItem pattern at lines 177-207.

approach.rationale:
VSCode inline menu buttons cannot have dynamic per-item titles (package.json is static). The spec solved this by moving the action to an expandable child item that can display any text. This follows the existing FileItem TreeItem pattern.
Key patterns being followed: - FileItem class structure at tasks-view.capability.ts:177-207 - ThemeIcon with ThemeColor at tasks-view.capability.ts:161-162 - TreeItem.command for click handling at tasks-view.capability.ts:183-188
ActionItem will be a new TreeItem class in the capability (VSCode API belongs in capabilities per architecture directive).

change.old: view/item/context menu entry for kanban.runNextAction on task items
change.new: No inline button - action is now an expandable child ActionItem
